sect2.title: Introduction
sect2.para: Zend_Service_SiteVerify is a client for the siteverify API shared by Google reCAPTCHA (v2 and v3), Cloudflare Turnstile and hCaptcha. The widget of the service puts a token into the submitted form; the client posts the token together with the secret key to the verification endpoint of the service and returns the decoded answer as a Zend_Service_SiteVerify_Response.
The Zend_Captcha_SiteVerify adapter uses this class; use it directly when the token is verified outside of Zend_Form, for example in an API endpoint.

sect2.title: Usage
sect2.para: The constructor takes the secret key, the provider name (one of the constants PROVIDER_RECAPTCHA, PROVIDER_TURNSTILE, PROVIDER_HCAPTCHA, or the verification URL of a compatible service) and optionally a Zend_Http_Client.

example.title: Verifying a token

sect2.para: verify() throws a Zend_Service_SiteVerify_Exception when the secret key is missing, the service cannot be reached, answers with an error status or without a JSON object. A token the service rejects is not an exception: isSuccess() returns FALSE and getErrorCodes() tells why.
Zend_Service_SiteVerify::getProvider($name) returns the settings of a known provider (verifyUrl, responseField, scriptUrl, widgetClass), which is what the captcha adapter renders the widget with.
